predecessors.name: Mayapan
predecessors.text: Maní, the Xiu capital; the page gives no extent

successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: Maní, the Xiu capital; the page gives no extent

ledger.x: 1441: 'the Xiu plotted revenge and in 1441 revolted against the Cocom' at Mayapan; the Xiu, who 'gradually lost control of Mayapan... by 1300' and were partly expelled 'in c.

About 1539: 'The first ambassadors from the Xiu met with Spanish conquistador Francisco de Montejo the Younger at Tuchi-caan, around 1539'; the conquest page says 'the Xiu Maya of Maní allied themselves with the Spanish'.
1547: 'In 1547 a Spanish mission was established at Mani, the Xiu capital.'
1547: the Xiu province passes under Spanish rule with the mission at Maní.

wars.name: Xiu revolt against Mayapan
wars.outcome: 'In 1441, Ah Xiu Xupan of the powerful noble family of Xiu' revolted and 'all of the Cocom family, except one ... were killed' (Mayapan page); the Xiu page: 'in 1441 revolted against the Cocom'.

certainty.note: No frontier is recorded; the Mani Land Treaty of 1557 settled the border with Sotuta and Cupul only after this state's end.
